hardware: 2 x RTX 5070 Ti 16 GB / 70 SM, native Windows, CUDA peer access unavailable
scope: Complete two-rank acceptance pipeline over resident represented BF16 target logits; no Engine/runtime integration
decision: Qualify the rank-zero candidate for a subsequent captured-runtime A/B, including event-copy fallback. Retain replicated acceptance for eager execution: the measured eager candidate is slower.

method.order: Alternating route order in paired rounds
method.baseline: Packed allgather to both ranks, argmax and unchanged speculative acceptance independently on both ranks
method.candidate: One-way gather to rank zero, rank-zero argmax and unchanged speculative acceptance, then exact compact decision replication and peer counter updates
method.graph_gather: Captured CUDA UVA copy and exact local integer interleave
method.graph_decision: Mapped mailbox, or event-ordered compact copy when mailbox disabled
method.timing: Host enqueue, complete wall and joined-device CUDA event intervals cover both ranks. State/counter reset, output poisoning and mailbox reset are outside timing. These overlapping metrics must not be added.

storage.decision_fields: Four licensed token slots plus frontier, anchor, licensed count and accepted count
storage.ownership: Caller-owned rank-local scratch with restored arena cursors; event ordering protects consecutive reuse. Captured mailbox slots stay immutable until both streams retire.
storage.scope: These are primitive scratch bounds, not a total runtime memory saving.

correctness.exact_gather: Independent raw BF16 concatenation on rank zero, preserving NaN payloads, signed zero and physical vocabulary padding; source logits unchanged
correctness.selection: Independent logical-domain argmax; physical padding is excluded from token selection
correctness.decision: All fields match the existing two-rank acceptance result exactly; source decision, sampler configs, drafts and extents remain unchanged
correctness.state: Frontier advances by licensed count; accepted prefix, correction/bonus anchor, licensed count and zero unused slots are checked
correctness.counters: Every licensed token including duplicates increments positive-temperature non-null counters exactly once; greedy rows and null counters remain unchanged; complete counter arrays are compared
correctness.sampling_math: The production sampler, penalties, filtering and counter-based RNG are unchanged. Pipeline stochastic checks use complete baseline parity plus independent state/counter invariants; probability correctness remains covered separately by the existing FP64 speculative joint-distribution suite.
correctness.lifetimes: Changed consecutive calls without host synchronization, guard checks, eager/captured replay and whole-graph update between two live owners
correctness.transports: Actual pinned publication and mapped-mailbox flags checked; captured event-copy fallback checked

validation.ninfer_speculative_rank0_test: Passed both device orders, including zero/short extents, repeated tokens, mixed greedy/stochastic rows, null counters, asymmetric shards, guards and graph update
validation.ninfer_allgather_columns_test: Passed existing independent exact gather regressions
validation.ninfer_speculative_round_test: Passed existing independent FP64 speculative-distribution and state regressions

limits: A faster isolated acceptance pipeline does not establish end-to-end committed-token throughput.
Eager candidate regresses in the measured configuration; no unconditional runtime replacement is recommended.
Measured pipeline is K3/B1 at the real padded vocabulary; correctness tests cover additional supported cases, not their performance.
Compact replication requires a valid acceptance decision and valid rank-local counter domains; it is not a malformed-token sanitizer.
Linux execution and direct-P2P performance were not tested locally.
